Interface for all renderable PDF elements

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`GetChildren`](#getchildren): Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery).
- [`GetPreferredWidth`](#getpreferredwidth): Gets the preferred width of this element, if any.

### `GetChildren`

```csharp
IEnumerable<IElement> GetChildren()
```

Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery). Container elements should override this to return their direct renderable children; leaf elements use the default empty implementation. A default interface method so existing `IElement` implementers outside this assembly remain source- and binary-compatible.

### `GetPreferredWidth`

```csharp
float GetPreferredWidth()
```

Gets the preferred width of this element, if any. This is used for auto-sizing in horizontal layouts.
